name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Builder
description: Builds MiniMax H3 prompts. Base modes write the three-field schema, a reference-mode switch writes the six-section Ref2VA format, and start/end image checkboxes add the keyframe instruction line. Character creator per subject composes a physical description from name, ethnicity, gender, age, height, build, hair and eyes. Sliding-window support, combined cast and subjects list, ordered beats with intra-shot timing, per-shot lens and rig, and audio references for voice, ambience and score.
author: JedsDeadBaby
